in_marathi.name: Vivekananda
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vivekananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Vivekananda' is derived from Sanskrit words 'Vivek' meaning wisdom and 'Ananda' meaning happiness or bliss. This name signifies the attainment of wisdom and the end of suffering. It is associated with the famous Indian monk Swami Vivekananda who spread the message of Vedanta philosophy to the western world.
